source_boundary.authoritative_language_rule: Use repository-local selected sources only. When paired Korean and English Altibase manuals, release notes, patch notes, tool manuals, technical documents, or third-party guides differ, derive expected facts from the Korean source and write the benchmark record in canonical English.

user_levels.definition: New Altibase user who needs version-aware orientation, safe first checks, and basic command or SQL examples without assuming DBA background.
User who understands general SQL or database operations and needs Altibase-specific syntax, objects, properties, and compatibility boundaries.
DBA or operations engineer handling installation, configuration, replication, backup, recovery, monitoring, troubleshooting, and service-impacting changes.
Application, API, migration, connector, or tooling user who needs driver, PSM, CLI, JDBC, ODBC, precompiler, utility, or integration details.
User asking version-sensitive, patch-specific, cross-manual, failure-mode, or high-risk operational questions where wrong assumptions would be costly.

source_families.label: Release notes and supported platform documents
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean release notes and Korean Supported Platforms where present; use English release notes and platform documents for English extraction and parity checks.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for version availability, upgrade cautions, changed defaults or ranges, new 8.1 features, tool release changes, and supported platform boundaries.

source_families.label: Patch notes
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean patch notes for patch-level behavior; use English patch notes only as supporting extraction where available.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use sparingly for patch-specific feature boundaries, changed behavior, compatibility fixes, and high-risk version caveats.

source_families.label: Getting Started and Installation manuals
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean manuals for installation and first-run behavior; use English manuals as extraction references.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for installation prerequisites, environment setup, database creation, startup, shutdown, and first health checks.

source_families.label: Administrator manuals and administrative SQL support
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean Administrator and SQL Reference manuals; use English manuals for extraction and wording parity.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for accounts, privileges, tablespaces, backup, restore, recovery, datafiles, logs, server modes, and administrative SQL.

source_families.label: SQL Reference manuals
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean SQL Reference manuals for syntax and restrictions; use English SQL Reference manuals for extraction and examples.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for DDL, DML, DCL, functions, expressions, hints, data type syntax, SQL generation boundaries, and Oracle-difference questions.

source_families.label: General Reference 1: data types and Altibase properties
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean General Reference 1 manuals; use English General Reference 1 manuals for extraction and English terminology.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for property catalog facts, defaults, ranges, dynamic-change support, data type definitions, JSON and LOB behavior, and property-related troubleshooting.

source_families.label: General Reference 2: data dictionary and performance views
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean General Reference 2 manuals; use English General Reference 2 manuals for extraction and object-name review.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for meta tables, performance views, object lookup SQL, property checks, version-sensitive view availability, and monitoring SQL.

source_families.label: Error Message Reference manuals
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean Error Message Reference manuals; use English references for extraction and customer-facing terms.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for error code message, cause, action, symptom mapping, and safe troubleshooting response structure.

source_families.label: Performance Tuning Guide manuals
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean performance material where selected; use English Performance Tuning Guides for extraction when Korean parity is not listed in the source inventory.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for optimizer, plan, index, join, statistics, trace, and tuning questions that require Altibase-specific plan or hint behavior.

source_families.label: Monitoring API Developer's Guide and SNMP Agent Guide
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean Monitoring API and SNMP Agent guides; use English guides for extraction and API terminology.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for monitoring API call sequences, SNMP configuration, ports, counters, traps, and operational monitoring integration questions.

source_families.label: Replication manuals
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean Replication Manuals and Korean SQL Reference for replication SQL; use English manuals for extraction and examples.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for replication topology, states, modes, DDL, prerequisites, failover/failback cautions, gap checks, and replication state-changing runbooks.

source_families.label: Log Analyzer User's Manuals
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean Log Analyzer manuals; use English manuals for extraction and API terminology.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for CDC, XLog Sender, XLog Collector, Log Analysis API, ODBC C conversion, and log-analysis runbooks.

source_families.label: Replication Manager tool manuals and release notes
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean Replication Manager tool manuals and release notes; use English tool manuals as extraction references.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for GUI-based replication management, connection prerequisites, panes, actions, and tool release boundaries.

source_families.label: Altibase SSL/TLS User's Guides
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean SSL/TLS guides when selected; use English SSL/TLS guides as extraction references. For 8.1 replication SSL, also verify against Korean release notes and Korean Replication Manual where present.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for listener/client TLS, certificate properties, cipher settings, network security cautions, and 8.1 replication SSL behavior.

source_families.label: Stored Procedures and External Procedures manuals
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean stored and external procedure manuals; use English manuals for extraction and PSM terminology.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for PSM syntax, stored procedure and function behavior, package-like migration cautions, external procedure setup, and PSM error handling.

source_families.label: JDBC, Adapter for JDBC, Java compatibility, Spring, and Hibernate sources
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean JDBC manuals, Adapter for JDBC manuals, JavaCompatibility, and Korean third-party guides where present; use English manuals and guides for extraction.
authoritative_path_patterns: 3rd Party Guide for Altibase/kor/Spring Data JPA*.md
supporting_path_patterns: 3rd Party Guide for Altibase/eng/Spring Data JPA*.md
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for JDBC URLs, driver classes, timeouts, LOB handling, Java compatibility, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, and Java-side troubleshooting.

source_families.label: CLI, ODBC, C Interface, and Precompiler manuals
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean CLI manuals where selected and Korean parity manuals where present; use English ODBC, C Interface, and Precompiler manuals for extraction.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for connection attributes, client API call flow, ODBC DSN setup, C Interface behavior, precompiler options, LOB API use, and diagnostics.

source_families.label: iSQL and iLoader manuals
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean iSQL and iLoader manuals; use English manuals for extraction and command examples.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for command-line SQL sessions, script execution, export/import/load workflows, format files, error files, and operational checks.

source_families.label: Utilities manuals and dataCompJ tool manuals
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean Utilities manuals, Korean dataCompJ manuals, and Korean tool release notes; use English material for extraction.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for aexport, altiComp, aku, altiMon, dataCompJ, dump tools, operational utilities, and tool-specific cautions.

source_families.label: Migration Center and Adapter for Oracle manuals
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean Adapter for Oracle, Migration Center manuals, and Migration Center release notes; use English material for extraction.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for Oracle-to-Altibase migration, compatibility reports, conversion limits, Adapter for Oracle, project options, comparison, and post-migration validation.

source_families.label: DB Link, Hadoop Connector, and external connector guides
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean DB Link, Hadoop Connector, third-party connector guides, and supporting Java compatibility material where present; use English material for extraction.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for DB Link syntax, DB Link monitoring views, Hadoop Connector setup, DBeaver, GoldenGate, and connector compatibility checks.

source_families.label: Kubernetes and AKU guides
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean Kubernetes and AKU guides and Korean release notes where present; use English third-party guides for extraction.
authoritative_path_patterns: 3rd Party Guide for Altibase/kor/Kubernetes User's Guide for Altibase.md
3rd Party Guide for Altibase/kor/Altibase aku Sample Guide for Kubernetes.md
supporting_path_patterns: 3rd Party Guide for Altibase/eng/Kubernetes User's Guide for Altibase.md
3rd Party Guide for Altibase/eng/Altibase aku Sample Guide for Kubernetes.md
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for container deployment, Kubernetes resources, AKU sample operations, and cloud/container caveats.

source_families.label: Spatial SQL, altiShapeLoader, NiFi, and Tableau sources
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean Spatial, altiShapeLoader, NiFi, and Tableau sources where present; use English manuals and guides for extraction.
authoritative_path_patterns: 3rd Party Guide for Altibase/kor/NiFi User's Guide for Altibase.md
3rd Party Guide for Altibase/kor/Tableau User's Guide for Altibase/*.md
supporting_path_patterns: 3rd Party Guide for Altibase/eng/NiFi User's Guide for Altibase.md
3rd Party Guide for Altibase/eng/Tableau User's Guide for Altibase/*.md
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for GEOMETRY, spatial SQL, altiShapeLoader configuration, NiFi database service setup, Tableau connection details, and related integration troubleshooting.

source_families.label: Approved supplemental technical documents
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean technical documents when paired or Korean-only; use English documents for extraction and customer-facing wording.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for approved compatibility matrices, network diagnostic procedures, Java compatibility details, and platform boundaries that are not fully covered by manuals.

source_families.label: Approved third-party integration guides
source_families.authority: Prefer Korean third-party guides where present; use English guides for extraction and UI/procedure wording.
source_families.coverage_notes: Use for Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Kubernetes, AKU, NiFi, Tableau, DBeaver, and other approved integration procedures; avoid unsupported integrations outside the selected corpus.

subdomain_targets.label: Property purpose, units, default, range, and value interpretation
Changed defaults, ranges, removed properties, and 8.1 additions
Dynamic versus static property change support and restart implications
V$PROPERTY and related view SQL for checking or verifying properties
Version-sensitive property behavior, including JSON, Temporary LOB, regex, logging, and replication SSL properties
Property-related symptoms, unsafe assumptions, and missing environment inputs

question_selection_notes: Favor properties that affect safety, startup, logging, memory, JSON, Temporary LOB, replication SSL, SQL plan output, and compatibility.
Require expected facts to state whether exact patch level, restart, or related view checks are needed.
Use property names as required tokens and prohibit generic database tuning advice that is not in the Altibase sources.
exclusion_notes: Do not create questions from properties that cannot be verified in the selected source corpus.
Do not ask the answering model to infer property behavior from source_refs or expected_facts.

subdomain_targets.label: Altibase-specific DDL for tablespaces, tables, partitions, indexes, constraints, users, privileges, and storage
DML, expressions, functions, hints, and Oracle-overlap differences
Data types, JSON, LOB, Temporary LOB, storage modifiers, and version boundaries
Oracle compatibility, migration-sensitive syntax, and unsupported generic assumptions
Replication SQL, administrative SQL, and DDL boundaries for high-risk changes
BNF-like syntax details, required clauses, and example generation constraints

question_selection_notes: Prefer questions that force Altibase-specific SQL or DDL instead of generic Oracle-compatible SQL.
Include required tokens for SQL keywords, property names, data type names, functions, and object placeholders.
For destructive or state-changing SQL, expected facts must require prerequisites, verification, and missing-object input.
exclusion_notes: Do not benchmark generic SQL behavior unless Altibase has a documented difference, restriction, or syntax pattern.
Do not create questions whose answer depends on an original syntax diagram that has not been converted or referenced in the selected source corpus.

subdomain_targets.label: Installation, database creation, startup, shutdown, first checks, and environment setup
Users, privileges, roles, tablespaces, memory/disk/temporary storage, and administrative SQL
Backup, restore, recovery, archive logging, incremental backup, and protected operational runbooks
Datafile, log file, checkpoint, backup directory, and storage movement operations
Supported platforms, release boundaries, upgrade cautions, and version selection
Safe operational sequencing, prechecks, rollback limits, and verification SQL

question_selection_notes: Include protected-topic questions for backup and recovery, datafile movement, destructive administrative operations, and startup/shutdown states.
Expected facts should require environment, object, file path, and log details when the safe procedure depends on them.
Prefer operational questions that need both manual procedure facts and verification SQL from dictionary/performance views.
exclusion_notes: Do not turn platform or Kubernetes supplemental notes into unsupported production architecture promises.
Do not create a runbook question if the selected sources do not provide the command or state transition being tested.

subdomain_targets.label: Meta tables and dictionary SQL for objects, privileges, partitions, comments, and storage
Performance views and check SQL for sessions, locks, waits, transactions, plan cache, replication, and backup state
Optimizer, plan interpretation, hints, statistics, indexes, joins, and tuning diagnostics
Monitoring API and SNMP setup, counters, ports, traps, and operational monitoring
Version-sensitive views, columns, and portable availability checks

question_selection_notes: Use view and column names as required tokens and require portable availability checks when view support differs by version.
Include questions that need multiple views, not just a single-object lookup.
Favor plan and monitoring questions where generic database answers are likely to miss Altibase-specific views or counters.
exclusion_notes: Do not benchmark direct DML against meta tables except as a prohibited claim.
Do not assume a view exists across all versions without source-backed availability or a V$TABLE/V$ALLCOLUMN check.

subdomain_targets.label: Replication topology, modes, states, objects, target matching, and runtime views
Create, start, stop, synchronize, flush, alter, and drop replication operations
Log Analyzer CDC, XLog components, Replication Manager workflows, and tool prerequisites
Replication compatibility, protocol versions, network diagnostics, ports, and gap checks
TLS, certificate configuration, client/server SSL, and 8.1 replication SSL
Version and patch-specific replication, CDC, security, and protocol caveats

question_selection_notes: Treat replication state changes and security/TLS as protected-topic candidates; expected facts should require version, topology, replication object names, gap status, and rollback cautions when needed.
Include cross-source questions that combine replication manuals, views, properties, release notes, and network technical documents.
Use literal tokens for replication SQL, view names, property names, ports, and tool/API names.
exclusion_notes: Do not imply replication automatically synchronizes DDL or resolves active-active conflicts unless the selected source says so.
Do not mix ordinary client TLS and replication SSL without preserving the documented version boundary.

subdomain_targets.label: Error code, message, cause, and action from Error Message Reference
Symptom triage, log collection, missing input requests, and first diagnostic commands
SQL, property, data type, JSON, LOB, and object-definition error scenarios
Backup/recovery, replication, security/TLS, and destructive-operation troubleshooting
Tool, driver, connector, iSQL, iLoader, utility, and API troubleshooting

question_selection_notes: Use literal error codes and messages as required tokens where present.
Expected facts should separate source-backed cause/action from environment-specific inference.
Include questions that test whether the answer asks for logs, exact SQL, object definition, version, or patch level only when needed.
exclusion_notes: Do not invent root causes not present in the selected source corpus.
Do not turn a generic symptom into a single-cause answer when the safe response requires more input.

subdomain_targets.label: PSM, stored procedures, functions, external procedures, and PL/SQL migration boundaries
JDBC, Adapter for JDBC, Java compatibility, Spring Data JPA, and Hibernate
CLI, ODBC, C Interface, Precompiler, LOB APIs, and C-side diagnostics
iSQL, iLoader, command options, data load/extract, and operational files
Utilities, aexport, altiComp, aku, altiMon, dataCompJ, and operational tools
Migration Center, Adapter for Oracle, Oracle compatibility, conversion reports, and validation
DB Link, Hadoop, third-party connectors, Kubernetes, AKU, and container procedures
Spatial SQL, altiShapeLoader, NiFi, Tableau, and miscellaneous approved integrations

question_selection_notes: Use exact class, method, package, option, property, path, command, and connector names as required tokens.
Prefer questions that require tool-specific prerequisites, generated files, version boundaries, and API call order.
Include UI-heavy guide questions only after translating the source procedure into canonical English facts and preserving literal technical tokens.
exclusion_notes: Do not include third-party tools or integrations outside the approved selected source inventory.
Do not rely on screenshots as expected facts unless the selected Markdown source exposes the needed field names or procedure text.
